input: Find founder- or family-owned US veterinary clinic groups with 5-30 locations

companies.name: Noah's Animal Hospitals
companies.hq: Indianapolis, IN (flagship hospital is Noah's Central Animal Hospital; corporate HQ address not stated on the pages I opened)
companies.ownership: founder-owned (Dr. R. Michael Thomas, President & Owner; family-operated)

criteria_evidence.evidence: Calls Dr. R. Michael Thomas 'president and owner of Noah's Animal Hospitals', 'the largest group of locally owned, family operated veterinary clinics in central Indiana' (as_of 2018-12-20).

criteria_evidence.criterion: Founder still owns the company (recent confirmation)
criteria_evidence.evidence: The All Pet Express page (unit opened Nov 2023) names Dr. Mike Thomas as 'President & Owner of Noah's Animal Hospitals'.
History starts in 1982, when Dr. Mike Thomas bought the hospital from retiring Dr. Howard Glass. It is AAHA-accredited.

The site lists 10 locations ('10 convenient locations'), all in Indiana: All Pet Express, All Pet Low-Cost Surgery Center, Brandywine, Caring Hands at Geist, North & Urgent Care, Noah's Animal Hospital & 24-Hour Emergency Center, Stop 11, Westside, Veterinary Specialty & Emergency Care South and West (as_of 2026-11-10).
No PE or consolidator deal found in news searches. It is not listed on privateequityvet.org's corporate vet list.

companies.traction: Opened All Pet Express, a low-cost hospital with a drive-thru option, in November 2023 (as_of 2023-11). The group now runs 10 locations, including 24-hour emergency and specialty hospitals (as_of 2026-11-10).
companies.rank_reason: Best fit. The founder is confirmed as owner, 10 locations sits in the middle of the 5-30 range, it has been operating since 1982, and it includes higher-value emergency and specialty units. It is a scaled, independent regional platform.

companies.name: Symbios Animal Health
companies.hq: New Jersey (HQ city not stated; hospitals are in Flemington, Whitehouse Station, Lebanon, Bedminster and Chatham, NJ)
companies.ownership: family-owned (co-owners Dr. Nick Pope, Dr. Elizabeth Pope and Dr. Jan Cailles)

criteria_evidence.evidence: Site says the hospitals are '100% independently and family owned' with 'no corporate parent and no outside investors'. Names co-owners Drs. Nick and Elizabeth Pope and Dr. Jan Cailles (as_of 2026-11-10).

Six NJ hospitals: Clover Hill (Flemington), Hunterdon Hills (Whitehouse Station), Oldwick (Whitehouse Station), South Branch Veterinary Services (Lebanon), Bedminster Veterinary Healthcare, and Symbios Chatham (as_of 2026-11-10).
Explicitly says it has 'no corporate parent and no outside investors'.

companies.traction: Six hospitals, including a newly opened Chatham site, all under one owner-veterinarian family (as_of 2026-11-10).
companies.rank_reason: Clearest statement of no outside capital, and 6 locations is within range. Ranked below Noah's because it is smaller, its founding year and headcount are unverified, and its growth history comes only from search snippets.

companies.name: Callanan Veterinary Group
companies.hq: Greater Boston, MA (HQ city not stated; hospitals in Medford, Watertown, Dorchester and Somerville, MA, and Warwick, RI)

criteria_evidence.evidence: Site says 'Family-owned and operated since 1926'. P.J. Callanan and Dr. Bourke founded Toureen Boarding Kennels in Brighton, MA (as_of 2026-11-10).

Five full-service hospitals: Wellington Circle Veterinary Center (Medford), Massachusetts Animal Medical Center (Watertown), Neponset Animal Hospital (Dorchester), Somerville Veterinary Center, and Rhode Island Animal Medical Center (Warwick) (as_of 2026-11-10).
Site still says family-owned and operated. No PE deal found in searches, and it is not on privateequityvet.org's corporate list.

companies.traction: Family-run for about 100 years (since 1926), with five full-service hospitals across MA and RI (as_of 2026-11-10).
companies.rank_reason: Family ownership is clearly confirmed across multiple generations, which suggests a possible succession or sale event. Five hospitals is the bottom of the range, and older job postings mention 6, so the count may have shrunk.

companies.name: Vet Partners Pet Hospital
companies.hq: Twin Cities, MN (locations in Plymouth, Edina, Apple Valley, Osseo and downtown Minneapolis)
companies.ownership: founder-owned (Dr. Angela Henninger and Dr. Luther Groth; current ownership is stated only as the 'local ownership' founding goal)

criteria_evidence.evidence: Founded in 2015 by Dr. Angela Henninger and Dr. Luther Groth 'to build multiple veterinary hospitals that maintain local ownership'. The site does not explicitly confirm the current cap table.
Five locations: Plymouth, Edina, Apple Valley, Osseo and Minneapolis (as_of 2026-11-10).
Directory page calls the Minneapolis site 'a locally-owned veterinary hospital'. No acquisition or investment news found.

companies.traction: Grew from founding in 2015 to five Twin Cities hospitals (as_of 2026-11-10).
companies.rank_reason: Founder-led and within range at 5 locations. Ranked last because current ownership is shown only by a stated 'local ownership' aim and directory pages, not an explicit ownership statement.

output.search_notes:
Only 4 groups could be verified against all criteria. I did not loosen any criterion to add more. Sources searched: vetintegrations.com consolidator roll call, dvm360's 'state of veterinary corporatization' list, privateequityvet.org's corporate vet list, company sites, press releases and local news.

Excluded:
- O'Brien Veterinary Group (Oak Brook, IL): calls itself family-owned, but privateequityvet.org lists The Cambria Group as owner, and Cambria's site has an O'Brien Veterinary Management portfolio page.
- VetnCare (Oakland, CA): backed by Great Point Partners since late 2022 (BusinessWire, 2026-07-14).
- Caring Hands Animal Hospital (VA): bought by Veterinary Practice Partners, an Audax portfolio company, in April 2023.
- Apollo Veterinary Medical Hospitals (Albany, GA): founder Dr. Steven Whatley, but Cyprium Partners made a non-control PE investment in 2023.
- Valley Veterinary Care: bought by Veterinary Innovative Partners in June 2024.
- Vets Pets (Wilson, NC): founding-family owned, but 36 locations listed on privateequityvet.org and '30+' in job posts, so above the 30 limit.
- Cara Veterinary (Seattle, 11 sites): calls itself family-owned, but privateequityvet.org lists 'Family investment groups, including the Haughey family', i.e. family-office capital rather than founder or operating-family ownership. Treat as borderline.
- Lakefield Veterinary Group: 70+ sites, too large, and Peloton Capital is involved.
- Inspire Veterinary Partners: publicly traded.
- Encore Vet Group: North Castle Partners is a shareholder.
- Firehouse Animal Health Centers (Austin, about 7 sites): ownership unclear; may share a corporate group with Goodheart and Mountain Star.
- Veterinary United (Bankstahl family): location count could not be verified.
- Wellness Animal Hospital (FL, 4 sites) and Animal Health Group (Staten Island, 2 sites): below 5.

missing_fields:
- All companies: employees, headcount_growth (no two dated headcount counts found on opened pages), last_round (none found; all appear self-funded or bank-financed).
- Symbios: founded_year.

Unverified leads (seen only in search snippets): a Feb 2024 Bucks County Today/Firstrust Bank profile said the Popes owned 3 practices, which would mean Symbios grew from 3 to 6, but the page returned 403. Noah's Central Animal Hospital's address (5510 Millersville Rd) and an 8-hospital count from older job listings also came only from snippets.
